What's new in Sonault 1.10.0

  • Starter sounds for new libraries. An empty library now offers a hand-picked pack of 16 free-license sounds: interface pops, impacts, and jingles by Kenney (CC0), rain and birdsong ambiences from Wikimedia Commons, and Apollo 13's famous "Houston, we've had a problem" radio call from NASA. You see the licenses before anything is added, every sound arrives with its creator, source link, and license already in its credit fields, and the whole pack sits under a Starter label so removing it later is one click.
  • More places to import from. Paste links from the Internet Archive, Wikimedia Commons, or any direct audio URL, alongside the existing YouTube and Freesound support.
  • In the ⌘K search palette, pressing Enter now filters the library by your query, and the selected sound always stays in view.
